experiment: Spatial error decomposition and latent context exchange

limitations: Corrections are fitted to native training targets independently per image/tile and are unavailable at inference.
Only scalar errors are retained. This is a spatial error decomposition, not a learned correction or a causal architecture diagnosis.
All sixteen validation captures are excluded. No game or sample is launched.

mechanical_tests.scope: Mechanical tests and one private scratch projection update only, not a trained quality candidate.

architecture.type: four-level hierarchical residual CNN with global context gate
architecture.input_receptive_field_pixels: whole image via global context gate
architecture.internal_downsampling: learned features only; original pixels retained through input rearrangement and residual path

decoder_conditioning.source: spatial mean of deepest encoder features, before the original context gate
decoder_conditioning.application: per-channel value*(1+scale)+shift after upsample/skip combination at all three decoder stages

latent_context.stages: input-to-latent cross-attention, one latent self-attention/MLP, latent-to-spatial cross-attention
latent_context.position_encoding: normalized xy coordinates projected into features, shared by read keys and write queries
latent_context.application: deepest encoder features before pooling, original context gate and decoder conditioning
latent_context.precision: FP32 training, FP16 inference; all stages included in complete graph timings

limitations: One Sponza scene plus sixteen training photo identities; seven different photo identities stay in validation, three at two emissions. Image identities and splits were fixed before the new captures and fitting. First-reset static frames only, not representative game or temporal validation.
No temporal training or quality validation.
Torch timing excludes D3D12 integration and is not a hidden-demo benchmark.

output_grading.scope: Unfitted algebraic approximation from the same runtime controls; other camera views reuse the parameters by inference.
output_grading.training: Differentiable FP32 operations after the clamped learned residual.
output_grading.inference: FP16 network, FP32 grading, FP16 final storage; all included in graph timing.

limitations: One 3D scene, optionally supplemented by static photograph planes; no representative game or temporal acceptance.
Validation identities stay out of fitting, but previous validation scores have informed research choices; not an independent final test set.
Pixel metrics do not establish preserved perceptual quality. No replacement is accepted.
Removing a learned branch changes the distribution seen by downstream layers; this is not a separately trained no-branch control.
Only 46 training images are evaluated, without fitting any weights. FP32 results are distinct from FP16 validation.
Feature and output changes are scalar diagnostics, not a native-quality or generalization pass.

residual_tests.scope: Finite FP16 patterns in selected operand combinations, not every possible triple.

conditioning_tests.scope: Finite half patterns in selected operand combinations, not every possible combination. Explicit round-to-nearest per operation.

limitations: Finite-input equivalence to existing student arithmetic, not native quality.
Complete student graph timings exclude D3D12 integration and do not accelerate native NVIDIA execution.
Exact full-image results cover only the checked checkpoints, inputs and environment.
Intervals average ten consecutive graph replays; p95 is an interval-average percentile, not per-frame tail latency.
Measured execution of experimental students plus grade, excluding D3D12 integration. No native-runtime acceleration.
One static input and one device; other desktop GPU work is not controlled.
No native-quality replacement is accepted or installed.
Spatial tile corrections use native training targets and are unavailable at inference. They do not prove latent attention is the correct architecture.
Perceiver IO supplies the read/process/write latent-interface idea. This is an original small CNN branch, not a replication of its trained models or benchmark results.
Data, seed, 4500 updates and example exposures match the small conditioned baseline, but extra parameters and attention increase computation.
Only 46 training and 16 validation first-reset frames are used. Validation remains outside fitting but informs research choices; no representative temporal or game acceptance is established.
Removing the trained branch changes downstream inputs and is not equivalent to independently training without it.
Existing optional CUDA fusions are checked on the new model. No new CUDA kernel or native-runtime acceleration is introduced in this experiment.
Full 1080p student-plus-grade graph timings exclude D3D12 integration. Alternating intervals average ten replays, not individual-frame tail latency.
No sample or game launch, no game/driver/native model or normal runtime changes.
